04FAQ
Does Riva replace a receptionist?

It answers when nobody can, then books, quotes and follows up.

Which languages?

English and French; the caller chooses.

Do I need technical skills?

No. A specialist sets it up and manages it.

Is it available?

Not yet. Book a call to join the first group of users.
